text.text_excerpt: Stopped here for a quick iced coffee to go on an early Saturday morning. It's located in a strip mall off Tchoupitoulas and if you come on a busy day, good luck parking! Service was friendly and quick. And my iced coffee was good. Only thing I found a little odd was all the random nicknacks for sale which I thought came off a little cheesy. Costume jewelry and candles? Totally takes away from the brand. I think they should focus more on selling items with the PJ's Coffee logo on it. The random items just cheapen the location. Aside from that observation, I would come back.

It's a PJ's, therefore I am a fan. They make the best iced mochas in the city, and New Orleans almost certainly makes the best iced mochas in the world, given the climate. So you pretty much can't go wrong. (Although I maintain my position that the one on Maple Street makes the best iced mochas. And no, I have no idea why.) Located in an Uptown strip mall, this PJ's is conveniently tucked away into a little corner and is perfect if you need a quick caffeine jolt to prepare you for some shopping. Or help you recover as the case may be. They've got tables out front, and the staff is super nice. Since it's Uptown and thus highly inconvenient to my house, I don't frequent this location very o...

Love this pj's! It can be a little tough with some small coffee places to get the same drink every time you order the same drink, but I have the best luck here. Staff is friendly and chatty, nice little set up inside if you want to munch on something while sipping your coffee, and it's connected to a FedEx store which just opens up all sorts of conveniences. And it's SO NICE to have a coffee shop with a big parking lot to access instead of searching for side street parking somewhere! They have a bike rack out front and a few tables outside too.
